You now have a daily goal. The Settings panel has a "Daily goal" field that accepts 1–20 and starts at 6. Under the session dots, the Timer shows progress like "3 of 6 today", and "🎉 Daily goal reached — nicely done!" appears once you hit the goal. I also renamed the panel's heading from "Durations" to "Settings", since it now holds more than durations.

What I tested and how:

Automated tests: all 25 pass, including 4 new ones:
The goal starts at 6.
Only whole numbers from 1 to 20 are accepted.
The goal is still there after a reload, and a bad saved value goes back to 6.
Only today's sessions count, so yesterday's don't. The progress line reads exactly "3 of 6 today", and the goal counts as reached when you hit it.
Real browser at 1280px and 375px: I started with one session already finished today and the goal at 6.
The Timer showed "1 of 6 today".
Typing 21 turned off the Save button.
Setting the goal to 2 changed the display to "1 of 2 today".
I ran a 1-minute focus session, sped up the browser's clock instead of waiting. The Timer then showed "2 of 2 today" with the celebration message.
After a reload, the goal, the count and the message were all still there. There were no errors, and the phone screenshot shows everything fits.
